01 /

When curiosity asks for proof.

Some questions will not stay on paper. They ask to be tested. I give them a few lines of Python and watch what happens. These small projects are not the end of an argument. They are where the next question begins.
SECURITY / PYTHON01
● ● ●$ python monitor.py --demo
study the timing, not the keys.

Cyber Python Toolkit

A keystroke leaves a moment behind. I wondered what that moment could tell us without keeping the words themselves. Cyber Python Toolkit is my opt-in Python experiment in unusually fast keypress timing. It studies the rhythm, not what someone types.

PythonTiming heuristicsPrivacy-aware

A timing signal can invite a question. It cannot prove a device is malicious. This remains a learning experiment.

Read the working pages
AI / AUTOMATION02
RESEARCH→DRAFT→REVIEW

GhostScribe

The news arrives faster than we can sit with it. GhostScribe begins by gathering cybersecurity and AI stories. Python and Gemini help draft carousel text, LinkedIn posts, and captions. Then the work returns to a person: to read carefully, choose what matters, and decide what deserves a voice.

PythonGeminiRSS

For now, this chapter ends at a text draft. Slide design and auto-posting are still unwritten.

Read the working pages
02 /

The person between the lines.

A mind that asks.
A heart that listens.

Behind the code, there is a person still learning how to look. Cybersecurity asks me to notice what a surface might hide. AI opens another question about what we could make. Poetry asks for a different kind of attention: to stay with what cannot be counted, and not hurry past it.

Python and Linux are part of my daily vocabulary. So are mistakes, unfinished thoughts, and the moment someone sees what I missed. I leave those things in the story. This is not a portrait of someone who has arrived. It is a page from someone still becoming.

M N MUSTAKUL AMIN TALUKDARStill becoming.

"Learning walks with me until death; knowledge grows with me until my last breath." - nowshirwan

03 /

The tools I carry along the way.

>_

When a question needs hands.

I reach for Python scripting, command-line tools, and Linux. An idea becomes something I can run, test, and return to.

[ ]

When an answer opens a door.

Cybersecurity fundamentals, generative AI, and AI content workflows give me new places to look. I begin with what I know, then make room for what I do not.

Aa

When a thought needs a reader.

I turn to tech storytelling, Instagram carousels, and LinkedIn content. A lesson feels different when I try to make it clear for someone else.

These are tools I carry, not names I hide behind. Their worth is in what they let me ask, make, and share.

FROM MY NOTEBOOK / 01
nowshirwanA line of my own
LINES I RETURN TO / REKHTA READING SHELF

Sometimes, a stranger’s verse
knows the weather within us.

Ghalib meets me in that restless place where one desire ends and another begins. His words are not mine. The recognition is: someone before me knew how much a heart could ask of a life.

Code asks me what happens next. A verse asks me what it feels like to be here. I need room for both. This shelf holds the lines I return to, with their poets’ names beside them.

ہزاروں خواہشیں ایسی کہ ہر خواہش پہ دم نکلے
بہت نکلے مرے ارمان لیکن پھر بھی کم نکلے
Hazaron khwahishen aisi ki har khwahish pe dam nikle
Bahut nikle mire arman lekin phir bhi kam nikle

A thousand desires, each so fierce it takes my breath;
many longings came to pass, yet still too few.
